newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Military Bank to merge finance units.
newsitem.headline: Thai Military Bank to merge finance units.

text.p: Thai Military Bank Plc shareholders have approved a plan for the bank's finance subsidiaries to merge, a report from one of Thai Military Bank's subsidiary brokers said on Wednesday.

"Yesterday's shareholders meeting approved a plan for the finance businesses of TMB's subsidiaries to consider merging and applying for a new bank licence," Thanapol Finance and Securities Plc said in a report.
Thai Military's subsidiaries include listed Nava Finance and Securities Plc, Thaimex Finance and Securities Plc TMX.BK and Thai Thanakorn Finance Plc, the report said.
Unlisted subsidiaries include Bangkok Asian Finance Co Ltd, Thanasap Finance and Securities Co Ltd and Thanapol Finance and Securities Plc, it added.
"The move to merge the finance businesses of TMB's subsidiaries will require splitting the finance and securities arms and no target date has been set for the proposed merger," the report said.
"TMB officials further announced that its earnings growth target in 1997 would be 12 percent, down from 18.4 percent reported earnings in 1996," Thanapol added.
The bank reported earnings of 4.918 billion baht in 1996 against 4.156 billion in 1995.
Thai Military Bank Plc is the sixth largest Thai bank in asset terms and major shareholders include the nation's armed services. ($1 = 26 baht)
